usual_baseline: Consent forms are usually complete, but the rest is not. Outcome scales are patchy: MADRS 0–71.4%, baseline CGI 20% [3192][3384][3559]. Cognitive checks fall after the course: 56.9% [3464], under 75% by completion [3544]. No 3- or 6-month follow-up [3418]. Risk/benefit discussion 50% [3347]. Right to withdraw explained to none [3523].
fix_that_works: Checklists, then an ECT discharge summary for every patient: legal status 5% to 100%, Mini-ACE 5% to 100%, MADRS 0% to 100% [3192].
fix_that_fails: No failed fix reported in these audits
consultant_advice: Only one of nine audits closed the loop. Consent paperwork is usually fine, so don't audit that alone. Audit outcome and cognitive monitoring through and after the course, including 3- and 6-month follow-up, which is where every service falls down.
